A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

Anvil After Hours

  1. Drop the three Anvils onto Zombies. Let Villagers pass safely. Time a group hit for a bigger combo.
  2. TAP AN ANVIL. 1 / 2 / 3 also work.
  3. Points, progress and the next target stay visible. END saves a result. Retry starts fresh.
